source_title: Neeraj Yadav's friend says she met him hours before he was found dead beside SUV
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Neeraj Yadav, a 42-year-old three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist, was found dead beside his SUV near Maujpur metro station in northeast Delhi Monday night in a suspected case of suicide. Yadav, who hailed from UP, used to run Anshneer Sports Academy in Haryanaâs Sonipat. According to her statement, she went to Sonipat on Oct 27 to meet Yadav and tell him she could no longer remain in touch with him. She told police Yadav later dropped her off at Maujpur in his SUV.Around 9pm, when the woman returned to the area near Gate No. 1 of Maujpur metro station to check on him, she found him lying on the road beside his vehicle and rushed him to hospital.Jafrabad police station has begun proceedings under BNSS Section 194, which deals with police inquiries and reports in cases of suicide and other unnatural deaths. âWe have not found any suicide note or video,â an officer said.Speaking to reporters, a relative of Yadav said, âHe had struggled, fought his way through difficulties and continued playing. It is difficult for me to believe that he could take the extreme step.âHe also said he was unaware of the woman who had accompanied Yadav before his death and called for her role to be examined.Despite being diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at the age of seven, Yadav pursued his sporting ambitions, playing wheelchair tennis between 2005 and 2012 before switching to para-athletics. He subsequently clinched two gold medals at the Hangzhou Asian Para Games in 2023, winning the javelin and discus events to take his career tally to three Asian Para Games titles.However, his career was clouded by an anti-doping case. National Anti-Doping Agency provisionally suspended him after an out-of-competition sample collected in Bengaluru in 2023 tested positive for stanozolol, an anabolic steroid. He sought DNA testing of his sample through the anti-doping disciplinary process.
